metadata.description: Skills for notella — handwritten note intelligence on your own machine.

plugins.name: notella
plugins.description: The notella pipeline: 22 Claude skills that turn photographed handwritten notebook pages in ~/notella/ into transcripts, structure, actions, daily/weekly/monthly/project syntheses with memory of their predecessors, longitudinal theme snapshots with deltas, guiding principles, ledgers (decisions, commitments, people, imports) and a human verdict loop (notella-review); image quality and orientation checks (upside-down, sideways, mirrored pages fixed from raw) and duplicate-safe imports (notella-images, notella-import). Operates the local notella-state facility; pairs with notella-desktop.
